appearances.snippet: Fortunately, we no longer have to use our imagination because a journalist over at The Atlantic did a deep dive after they also received a tip. In addition, they received access because this group is closed on Discord by someone who wanted to expose what was happening. And believe it or not, it is going to be an operation with strong ties to Eastern Europe, and the videos are being supplied by a very close friend of Erika Kirk's. So let's jump into this article. I'm mind blown by it. Credit to Ali Breland. It is entitled Inside a Conservative Operation to Hijack Your Social Media Feed. And then the subtitle there says a service run from Latvia offers payment for short social media friendly clips designed to look like it's grassroots GOP support.
